title: Figure 15. Three Types of Error in DNA Tile Self-assembly (growth, facet, nucleation)
description: Three-row schematic of triangular DNA tile assemblies built from patterned square tiles: (a) a growth error with a tile labeled "Mismatched," (b) a facet error with tiles attaching at a labeled "Facet," and (c) a nucleation error showing loose tiles forming a "Random assembly." Captioned "Figure 15. Three Types of Error in DNA Tile Self-assembly (a) Growth error (b) Facet error (c) Nucleation error. Red lines indicate the mismatched sides."
